pid_file.description: Path to the file where Apache writes its process ID.

timeout.description: Number of seconds before receives and sends time out.

max_keepalive_requests.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per persistent connection.

keepalive_timeout.description: Number of seconds Apache waits for the next request on a persistent connection.

user.description: User account under which Apache runs.

server_admin.description: Email address displayed in server-generated error messages.

server_name.description: Server hostname (optional). If empty, omitted from config.

directory_index.description: List of default filenames to serve when a directory is requested.

error_log.description: Path to the global error log file.

log_level.description: Verbosity level for error logging (e.g., debug, info, notice, warn, error, crit, alert, emerg).

included_module_configs.description: List of additional module config files to include. Each item has a 'path' field.

path.description: Absolute path to a module configuration file.

modules_to_load.description: List of modules to explicitly load. Each item has 'name' and 'path' fields.

path.description: Absolute or relative (to ServerRoot) path to the module .so file.

listen_addresses.description: List of addresses and ports Apache should listen on (e.g., '80', '127.0.0.1:443').

virtual_hosts.description: Virtual hosts to configure. Each item defines a <VirtualHost> block.

server_name.description: Primary domain name for this virtual host.

server_alias.description: Additional domain names for this host (e.g., 'www.example.com').

document_root.description: Filesystem path to the document root.

error_log.description: Per-vhost error log path. If empty, uses global.

custom_log.description: Access log path for this virtual host.

log_format.description: Log format name or custom spec (e.g., 'combined', '%h %l %u %t "%r" %>s %b').

allow_override.description: Controls which directives may appear in .htaccess (e.g., 'All', 'None', 'AuthConfig').

proxy_backend.description: Backend URL to proxy all requests to (e.g., 'http://127.0.0.1:8080'). If empty, omitted.

balance_name.description: Name of the balancer cluster (used with proxy_balancer).

balance_member_list.description: List of backend servers for load balancing.

load_balancers.description: Standalone balancer clusters (for reuse across vhosts or standalone use).
